the dorsal cortical stream comes online quickly during the learning of complex auditory–motor tasks, that individual variability is reflected by differences in neural recruitment of auditory encoding and motor-control regions during the learning process, and that pre-SMA activation and its interaction with the auditory system are predictors of learning success.

the neural network that supports auditory-to-motor transformations in the dorsal auditory stream emerges quickly during training, and that individual differences in performance during training are reflected in the recruitment of brain regions involved in auditory and motor control.

the neurophysiology of auditory–motor learning and the neural correlates of individual variability.
the neural mechanisms of auditory–motor learning and the neural predictors of learning performance.
